theDefect.statement: A guard nothing invokes is not a guard. 619 assertions across 14 builders sat inside a selfTest() reachable only through process.argv.includes("--self-test"), and nothing in .github/ or the integration chain passed that flag.

measuredAtBase.note: The checker's own header said 676. That was not a reading of this tree; it has been corrected to the measured 619.

theDefect.priorProof: VF61 reintroduced the exact defect FIX166 had repaired in il-seal-3yr-set and a plain build exited 0 and wrote the fabricated literals to disk. FIX173 re-measured that itself rather than taking it on report: see the il-seal-3yr-set break below.

caseOne_ca_1203_4_set.symptom: build-census-v1-ca-1203-4-set.mjs was the one builder of the fourteen whose --self-test failed, on an assert.deepEqual over a family-id list.
caseOne_ca_1203_4_set.whatTheListIsFor: Object.keys(FAMILIES) -- a census of the packet families this copy of the WEST engine serves, asserted against a literal so that a family arriving or leaving cannot pass unremarked.
caseOne_ca_1203_4_set.howResolved: ca-1203-4-set belongs in FAMILIES; the literal was stale, and two more literals beside it were stale the same way. All three were copied verbatim from the sibling engine build-census-v1-az_marijuana_expungement_arrest_no_charges-set.mjs, whose FAMILIES legitimately holds nine, and never grew the tenth entry when this copy took ownership of its namesake family.
evidenceThatTheRegistryWasRight: ca-1203-4-set is this engine's FIRST_FAMILY and the file's namesake.

It is the only CA family here carrying an assignmentOwnedPath, which is the marker of a family a copy builds rather than reads; the AZ sibling carries the marker on its own two AZ families and on no CA one.
It has matching per-family entries in CA_ROUTE_VARIANTS and CA_PARTICIPANT_GUIDANCE and its own scripts/census-v1-ca-1203-4-set/ pikepdf readers.
Its overlay directory data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/ca/ca-1203-4-set--official-pdf-fill is committed with 51 files including 30 fixture PDFs.
MASS_PACKET_PRODUCTION_150.json declares familyId ca-1203-4-set against scripts/build-census-v1-ca-1203-4-set.mjs with overlayDirectoryExists true and the same five form numbers FAMILIES gives it.
Removing it from FAMILIES would fail the CA_ROUTE_VARIANTS census that sits below the assertion, which requires the CA family keys of the two registries to match.

For the second stale literal, the useMeasuredMc031Labels census: every CA family whose formNumbers carry MC-031 takes the measured MC-031 labels, ca-1203-4-set carries MC-031, and ca-1203-43-set, which does not, is correctly absent.

For the third, repaired1203Families: the committed production-field-map.json of ca-1203-4-set carries the measured CR-106 caption basis exactly as ca-1203-41-set's does, and ca-17b-reduction-set, which does not take that repair, carries none.
caseOne_ca_1203_4_set.nothingWasWeakened: The MC-031 census gained a derived invariant beside the literal, and repaired1203Families now drives its per-family CR-106-label and participant-instruction loops over a fifth family.

caseTwo_guardsMovedIntoTheBuildPath.method: For each builder, the assertions that read a file the build writes were moved into a named function the build path calls after its last write, with selfTest() kept as a thin wrapper so --self-test still audits the committed tree. Each move was then proved behaviourally: a defect the moved assertion is meant to catch was reintroduced, the builder run with NO FLAGS against the committed builder and against the repaired one, and the two exit codes and the on-disk consequence recorded. Every break was then restored and the family rebuilt, and the directory compared file by file against the committed tree.
caseTwo_guardsMovedIntoTheBuildPath.assertionArithmetic: The eleven builders changed here carried 430 flag-gated assertions at 63a28b5f. 48 stay behind the flag by decision -- 26 in mi_setaside_trafficking-set and 22 in az_marijuana_expungement_limited_jurisdiction-set, both frozen-constant censuses -- so 382 assertions that had never run in a build now run in one. The counts are the checker's own reading of each selfTest body, before and after.

builders.leftBehindAndWhy: everyPageRastered and rasterPages.length. A build legitimately moves both -- a host with a calibrated rasterizer rasters locally and a host without one does not -- so they stay a --self-test reading of the committed review state. Measured: a plain build on this host moves exactly those two keys plus their two counterparts in build-status.json and nothing else. The 26 assertions still in selfTest() assert this builder's own frozen constants (the corpus-index entry, the MC-227B field dictionary, the two fixtures) rather than anything on disk, and the build path already re-derives the same facts from the pinned binary in censusOf and asserts the delivered map's shape in the moved half.

Pre-existing and not this lane's doing: measured on the committed builder before any edit. The tree here is restored. Raised for the Captain -- it is the class verify-governance-state-survives-rebuild.mjs exists for.

buildersLeftAloneAndWhy.why: This one is the second kind almost entirely. It runs a --dry-run build, constructs synthetic PDFDocuments and saves and reloads them to measure decoded content streams and added vector ink, unit-tests pure functions (safeSourcePath, protectCategoryOf, semanticRole), and drives mutation harnesses through assert.throws and assert.rejects. Running that on every build would make the build construct scratch documents to test itself. Its only touch of an output tree is an existsSync on two reports belonging to a different family, which is not an invariant of the family being built.

The WEST engine's delivered-evidence checks are not in selfTest at all: they are in checkCa, which buildCa reaches through caCompletionEvidenceReady before it writes the approval request. Measured, not assumed -- the full build of ca-1203-4-set on this host exited 1 inside checkCa, at assertDistinctRouteArtifactsWhenAvailable, reached from buildCa. What remains in selfTest is a registry and source-contract census (FAMILIES, CA_ROUTE_VARIANTS, AZ_FIELD_SPECS, typeof and String(fn) contract checks) plus fixture-level harnesses: no assertion in it reads this family's OUT tree.
The same engine, the same shape: buildAz reaches checkAz through azCompletionEvidenceReady before the approval request is written, and no assertion in this copy's selfTest reads its OUT tree.
See the Michigan entry above: the delivered half moved, the frozen-constant half did not.
See the Arizona limited-jurisdiction entry above.

caseThree_theGate.position: fourth tripwire, after verify-governance-state-survives-rebuild.mjs and before extract-verifier-returns.mjs
caseThree_theGate.whyTheNumberFalls: The checker's scope is what is still dormant. A builder whose guards move into its build path stops being in scope, which is the measurement working rather than coverage being lost.
changesToTheCheckerItself: Its restore was a blanket `git checkout -- data/rcap-all50`. In the integration chain that runs inside a worktree which may hold a lane's uncommitted packet work, and a blanket checkout would discard it silently. It now records what is already dirty under the overlays before the run and restores only paths that were clean before and are dirty after. Proved by dirtying reports/build-summary.json under il-seal-3yr-set, running the checker, and finding that modification still there afterwards with nothing else left behind.
Its header claimed 676 assertions. The reading of this tree at 63a28b5f is 619; corrected.

covers: a builder whose assertions are reachable only through --self-test is found, and its assertion count is right
a builder with no selfTest is not found
a builder whose selfTest is called unconditionally is not found
a builder whose guard has moved into the build path with selfTest left as a thin wrapper is not found -- the shape this lane leaves behind
a flag-gated selfTest holding no assertions is not counted as a dormant guard
non-builder scripts beside the builders are left alone
an empty scripts directory yields an empty scope rather than throwing

Nothing was run against the full integration chain: this lane added its step and verified the step, and running integrate.mjs would rewrite the master queue, which is not a MACHINERY lane's to do.
